scripts.test: npx cucumber-js tests/features --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:ui: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:healthcheck: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/allsites.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:selfheal: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/allsites.feature tests/features/UIFeature/admin.feature tests/features/UIFeature/partRequest.feature --require tests/steps/ui/link_steps.js --require tests/steps/ui/admin_steps.js --require tests/steps/ui/partRequest_steps.js --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:parts-request: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/partRequest.feature --tags @parts-request --require tests/steps/ui/admin_steps.js --require tests/steps/ui/partRequest_steps.js --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:admin: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/admin.feature --require tests/steps/ui/admin_steps.js --require tests/steps/ui/link_steps.js --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:filters: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/inventory_filters_corrected.feature --require tests/steps/ui/admin_steps.js --require tests/steps/ui/inventory_filters_steps.js --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:testimonial: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/testimonial.feature --require tests/steps/ui/admin_steps.js --require tests/steps/ui/testimonial_steps.js --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:all-tags: npm run test:admin && npm run test:parts-request && npm run test:filters && npm run test:testimonial
scripts.test:site-prerequisite:admin: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/sitePrerequisiteImageCapture.feature --tags "@SitePrerequisite and @admin" --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:showroom: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/showroom.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:healthcheck:all: concurrently "npm run test:healthcheck:chromium" "npm run test:healthcheck:firefox" "npm run test:healthcheck:webkit"
scripts.test:healthcheck:chromium: cross-env BROWSER=chromium npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/allsites.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:healthcheck:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/allsites.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:healthcheck:webkit: cross-env BROWSER=webkit npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/allsites.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:api: npx cucumber-js tests/features/APIFeature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:performance: npx cucumber-js tests/features/performance --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js
scripts.test:cucumber: npx cucumber-js --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format ./Setup/allureReporter.js --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:api && npm run test:performance
scripts.test:report: npm run test && npm run report:generate && npm run report:summary && npm run report:test-summary
scripts.report:generate: node Setup/preserveAllureHistory.js && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:open: npm run report:generate && npm run report:summary && npm run report:report
scripts.report:generate:healthcheck: node Setup/preserveAllureHistory.js && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:open:healthcheck: npm run report:generate:healthcheck && npm run report:summary && npm run report:report
scripts.report:generate:selfheal: node Setup/preserveAllureHistory.js && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:open:selfheal: npm run report:generate:selfheal && npm run report:summary && npm run report:report
scripts.report:generate:valkey: node Setup/preserveAllureHistory.js && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:open:valkey: npm run report:generate:valkey && npm run report:summary && npm run report:report
scripts.report:generate:showroom: node Setup/preserveAllureHistory.js && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:open:showroom: npm run report:generate:showroom && npm run report:summary && npm run report:report
